title: Prime Numbers (Method)
hints: Numbers smaller than 2 are never prime: return false right away.
Try every divisor d from 2 up to n - 1. If n % d == 0, it's not prime.
Faster: you only need to try divisors while d * d <= n.

mustContain.message: Keep the method signature: static boolean isPrime(int n).
